original_8_features: Mode of Transport to the Hospital
final_features_used: Mode of Transport to the Hospital
notes: Age and Time Taken To Reach Hospital are bucketed range strings, encoded ordinally, not treated as free numerics.
Dropped ['Gender', 'Vehicle Type', 'Helmet Worn'] after train-only chi-square/Cramer's V validation showed p>0.05 or Cramer's V<0.05.
Rare categories in Collision With / Site of Injury No1 (< 20 training rows) consolidated into 'Other', fit on train only.
Class imbalance (78% Moderate / 22% Severe) handled via class_weight='balanced', checked against SMOTE - no improvement, so class weighting kept.
CatBoost's categorical NaNs are cast to the string 'missing' due to a library-level type requirement - a representation fix, not imputation.

Model AND threshold chosen together (Section 8) via a joint sweep across all tuned candidates, constrained to recall(Moderate) >= 0.5 - picking the threshold-winner for only the model chosen at the default threshold (the original approach) produced a degenerate near-all-Severe model on this data and was replaced.
Confidence-layer simplified to a 2-tier design (40% completeness floor, 0.60 model-probability floor for a low-confidence flag) to match the agreed specification exactly.
